Game Overview

Ocean Small Hospital - Doctor! is a casual game built around embark on a submarine adventure as a heroic doctor, rescuing injured sea animals. Diagnose and treat adorable ocean creatures using special tools in your underwater hospital. With engaging tasks and vibrant visuals, experience the joy of animal care while learning and having fun in Ocean Small Hospital Doctor.
